DICOM3D Three.js / React Three Fiber alpha runtime attribution

DICOM3D's original code is licensed under Apache License 2.0; see the repository
LICENSE and NOTICE. This file records separate software used by the alpha runtime.
It does not change those components' licenses or the anatomy/data licenses.

Direct runtime framework versions:
  React 19.2.7                    MIT; Meta Platforms and contributors
  React DOM 19.2.7                MIT; Meta Platforms and contributors
  Three.js 0.180.0                MIT; Three.js authors
  React Three Fiber 9.6.1         MIT; Poimandres

Runtime dependency license notices retained from the locked installed packages:
  @babel/runtime 7.29.7           MIT
  base64-js 1.5.1                 MIT
  buffer 6.0.3                   MIT
  ieee754 1.2.1                  BSD-3-Clause
  its-fine 2.0.0                 MIT

  suspend-react 0.1.3            MIT
  use-sync-external-store 1.6.0   MIT
  zustand 5.0.14                 MIT

Full publisher license texts are in third-party/alpha/. React and React DOM retain
their respective original license files even where their text is identical.
These notices describe the locked dependency set; they are not an inventory of
separately selectable anatomical structures or an assertion that every dependency
contributes code to every optimized build.

The installed @react-three/fiber npm package declares MIT but omits its LICENSE
file. Its retained license was obtained from the primary upstream source at:
https://github.com/pmndrs/react-three-fiber/blob/2a528745e9aa7c9e6cca41e404b59d45cf0d0cc7/LICENSE
That commit is both the npm 9.6.1 gitHead and upstream v9.6.1 tag.

Current alpha build-tool notices are also retained byte-for-byte:
  Vite 8.2.4                     MIT and its included third-party notices
  Rolldown 1.2.13                MIT and its THIRD-PARTY-LICENSE
These identify the locked assembly tools, not additional browser features. They
do not replace historical notices for other versions elsewhere in the repository.

BodyParts3D and HRA generalized anatomy have separate CC BY 4.0 attribution and
preserved historical notices in their admitted asset directories. The public H000
CT/SEG example has its own source notices and admission contract. None of these
sources is relicensed by this software notice, and no patient-atlas registration
or clinical correctness is implied.

Legacy Babylon and build-tool notices elsewhere in third-party/ remain historical
source material. They do not identify the renderer or runtime versions of this
Three/R3F alpha.
